---
title: Create your config repo
guide-section: Get started
---

1. Open [ha-automations-config-template](https://github.com/joshwlivingston/ha-automations-config-template).
2. Select **Use this template > Create a new repository**.
3. Choose **Private**. `apps.yaml` names the devices in your home.

## What is in it

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `apps.yaml` | Your apps and their settings, with an example of each app |
| `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` | The deploy workflow |

Edit only the workflow's schedule. See [Set up deploys](deploy.qmd).
